name: Read emails and create summary note
goal: Across every Mail account's INBOX, inspect up to its first 3 messages, compare their date received values, and read the 3 most recent emails overall (including their actual content). Create a note in Notes titled 'Agent Test - Mail Summary'. Include each email's exact subject and specific details from its actual content (sender names, amounts, dates, etc.), not just subjects.

command: get name of note "Agent Test - Mail Summary"

verify.description: Note contains the exact subjects of the 3 globally newest inbox messages

source_command:
set newestDate1 to missing value
set newestDate2 to missing value
set newestDate3 to missing value
set newestSubject1 to missing value
set newestSubject2 to missing value
set newestSubject3 to missing value
set accountCount to count of accounts
repeat with accountIndex from 1 to accountCount
  set accountRef to account accountIndex
  set boxRef to mailbox "INBOX" of accountRef
  set messageCount to count of messages of boxRef
  set takeCount to 3
  if messageCount < takeCount then set takeCount to messageCount
  repeat with messageIndex from 1 to takeCount
    set messageRef to message messageIndex of boxRef
    set candidateDate to date received of messageRef
    set candidateSubject to subject of messageRef as text
    if newestDate1 is missing value then
      set newestDate1 to candidateDate
      set newestSubject1 to candidateSubject
    else if candidateDate > newestDate1 then
      set newestDate3 to newestDate2
      set newestSubject3 to newestSubject2
      set newestDate2 to newestDate1
      set newestSubject2 to newestSubject1
      set newestDate1 to candidateDate
      set newestSubject1 to candidateSubject
    else if newestDate2 is missing value then
      set newestDate2 to candidateDate
      set newestSubject2 to candidateSubject
    else if candidateDate > newestDate2 then
      set newestDate3 to newestDate2
      set newestSubject3 to newestSubject2
      set newestDate2 to candidateDate
      set newestSubject2 to candidateSubject
    else if newestDate3 is missing value then
      set newestDate3 to candidateDate
      set newestSubject3 to candidateSubject
    else if candidateDate > newestDate3 then
      set newestDate3 to candidateDate
      set newestSubject3 to candidateSubject
    end if
  end repeat
end repeat
if newestSubject3 is missing value then error "fewer than 3 inbox messages across all accounts"
return newestSubject1 & linefeed & newestSubject2 & linefeed & newestSubject3
target_command: get plaintext of note "Agent Test - Mail Summary"
cross_check.description: Note must contain every exact subject captured at task start

verify.description: Note is not empty / not just subjects
command: get plaintext of note "Agent Test - Mail Summary"

set noteIDs to get id of every note whose name is "Agent Test - Mail Summary"
if (count of noteIDs) is greater than 0 then
  set stableID to item 1 of noteIDs
  delete note id stableID
end if
return "cleaned"
verify:
set remaining to count of (every note whose name is "Agent Test - Mail Summary")
if remaining is not 0 then error "cleanup left " & remaining & " mail summary note(s)"
return "cleaned"
